profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Alocity
profile.summary: Software Engineer graduated in 2012, mainly focused in software design for embedded systems. Team working skills, group communication and interaction, creative and problem solving abilities.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: C# · .NET Framework · Entity Framework (EF) Core · Go (Programming Language) · Microsoft SQL Server

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Software developer for embedded systems running custom Android OS used for access control, android mobile apps, RESTful API, front-end website. Eclipse, Android Studio, Visual Studio.
    • Customized Android OS for enabling some hardware components like GPIOs and serial ports in the hardware layer.
    • Implemented custom Android Launcher to handle system updates, app crashes etc...
    • Device security optimizations by disabling the Android Debug Bridge, obfuscating APK file, using custom launcher, enabling Kiosk mode.
    • Implemented libraries to access serial ports for fingerprint sensors, RFID and magnetic card readers using Java and C/C++.
    • Developed apps for custom Android OS using Java, and C/C++ native code with NDK toolset.
    • Developed Android mobile apps using Java and Xamarin with .NET framework.
    • Used C/C++ native code to improve performance when accessing the hardware layer from Android apps.
    • Test and debug applications on multiple Android targets and deploy in Marketplace supporting different releases of Android OS.
    • Integrated client side application with server API via asynchronous tasks.
    • Implemented module for handling hardware GPIO and communication ports using Java, C/C++.
    • Experience with Docker containerization, Docker Compose and Kubernetes.
    • Created RESTful API, .NET core, C#, Entity Framework, LinQ, PostgreSQL database.
    • Worked in front-end website, React, NextJS, Javascript, Typescript, HTML, CSS.

positions.title: Software Developer for Embedded Systems
positions.locationName: Miami/Fort Lauderdale y alrededores, Estados Unidos
positions.description:
Software Developer for Embedded Systems
    • .NET framework, C#, XML, WPF, Visual Studio. Windows IoT application running on a Raspberry Pi.
    • Implemented software in Arduino platform for sensor data acquisition, motor control, WIFI and magnetic card reader. C/C++.
    • Developed Android Mobile App for Installation guide. Java, Android Studio.

positions.title: Research and Development Engineer
positions.description:
Worked with Dr. Adrian Chan who’s the associate dean of systems and computer engineering at Carleton University (http://www.sce.carleton.ca/faculty/chan/) on a research project to improve person recognition.
    • Implemented library to collect fingerprinting images using an USB fingerprint sensor. C++, Qt Creator.
    • Implemented library to collect ECG (electrocardiogram) signals. C++, Qt Creator.
    • Developed desktop application to combine Fingerprint and ECG simultaneously to identify a person in advanced security systems. C++, Qt Creator, Matlab.

company.name: Systems and Computer Engineering, Carleton University

positions.title: Research and Development Engineer
positions.description:
Software Developer for Embedded Systems, implementing firmware and high level applications.
    • Implemented library to collect, filter and process ECG (electrocardiogram) signals for an ambulatory patient monitor. C++, Qt Creator.
    • Implemented library to collect, filter and process blood pressure signals for an ambulatory patient monitor. C++, Qt Creator.
    • Implemented driver for a thermal printer to printout ECG signals for an ambulatory patient monitor. C++, Qt Creator.
    • Implemented firmware for a device that collects ECG biomedical signals using Bluetooth and transmit these signals to an online server over GSM/GPRS network. C/C++, IAR Embedded Workbench.

projects.title: A mobile terminal to follow-up the evolution of chronic diseases
projects.description:
On this project I have worked on the hardware and firmware design of a low
cost and consumption portable device intended to collect
(Bluetooth) and transmit (GSM/GPRS) biological signals to a
website. This solution forms part of an ambulatory monitoring
system for patients with related heart diseases like arrhythmia,
hypertension and diabetes, giving a more close interaction
between patients and doctors. The hardware is based on the
MSP430F5419A microcontroller, the CC2540 Bluetooth Low
Energy (both from Texas Instruments), and the SIM908
GSM/GPRS/GPS modem from Simcom. The real time
operating system FreeRTOS was used in the firmware. QRS
complexes are detected and processed in the ECG wave signal;
blood pressure and glucose level are processed as well. A
robust communication protocol was implemented and an easy
graphical user interface also. A total of 50 different samples
were uploaded to the website using developed prototypes in a
safety way. This is an interesting solution to have into account
in this kind of systems due to its low cost.
